what_it_does.title: What it does and
what_it_does.desc: It's not magic, it's pure math. Explore the real-world use cases that moz-utils solves for you.

nuit.title: NUIT Validation
nuit.details: We don't just use Regular Expressions. The library applies the official mathematical algorithm required by the Mozambican Tax Authority to calculate and validate the NUIT check digit.

bi.title: National ID (BI) Validation
bi.details: Whether it's the old BI (12 numbers + 1 letter) or the most modern emissions, the tool verifies the structures and formats established by DIC.

phone.title: Phones and Networks
phone.details: Automatically detects whether a number belongs to Tmcel, Vodacom, or Movitel. It also handles international prefixes (+258) and landline numbers.

geo.title: Local Geography
geo.details: Contains an integrated, high-performance (O(1)) database to query postal codes and map provinces to districts without needing internet access.

cards.title: 100% Test Coverage

cards.title: Zero Dependencies
cards.description: Extremely lightweight packages that do not bloat your project. All code is native to the chosen language.

cards.title: Embedded Geographic Data
cards.description: Full validation of Postal Codes (old and new) and offline mapping of Mozambique's Provinces and Districts.

cards.title: Strict Typing
